methods.text: not available for Mississippi: MDOT publishes no crash-cost table: its HSIP report says projects are ranked by benefit/cost from Safety Countermeasure Alternative Reports, but the unit costs aren't published (HSIP 2025, 'Program Methodology')
not available for Mississippi: MDOT publishes no statewide average crash-rate table, and CrashIQ has no Mississippi traffic counts

Highway Safety Manual (AASHTO, 1st, 2010), Ch. 4, Sec. 4.2.3. Mississippi's own method, MDOT HSIP project identification: crash frequency, crash rate, excess proportions of specific crash types, relative severity index (HSIP 2025 report, 'Program Methodology'; text extract, page not recorded), isn't built: this report uses the HSM critical rate against the corridor's own sites (national method)

not available for Mississippi: MDOT states no minimum years for a corridor study; its HSIP evaluates projects on a five-year before-and-after crash analysis (HSIP 2025 report, 'Program Evaluation'), which is an evaluation window, not a study minimum
